Neither says that device support varies or that cues should be tested on real devices. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both give a clear verdict for each candidate, keep sound and vibration for the two moments when the customer isn't looking, and reject the buzz on every button. B rejects the jingle outright and covers more of the safeguards: an in-app off switch, silent mode and Do Not Disturb, and never relying on the cue alone, with accessibility as a reason.
